description: Chuck's double life becomes harder to contain as his feelings for Sarah deepen, Fulcrum closes in and the Intersect changes from an unwanted burden into something he increasingly chooses to confront.

s02e01.description: A missing component for the new Intersect makes Chuck believe freedom is finally close, encouraging him to plan a real date with Sarah even as Casey receives an order that could end Chuck’s life.

s02e02.description: Legendary seduction expert Roan Montgomery trains Chuck for an undercover operation against a dangerous arms dealer, forcing Chuck to imitate a kind of confidence he does not naturally possess.

s02e03.description: Bryce returns for a mission requiring him and Sarah to pose as a married couple, leaving Chuck jealous while the team tries to stop an international technology theft.

s02e04.description: Sarah reluctantly attends her high-school reunion with Chuck and encounters former tormentor Heather Chandler, whose apparently perfect adult life conceals a connection to stolen weapons technology.

s02e05.description: A terrorist targets Jeff because of his old mastery of the arcade game Missile Command, forcing Chuck to uncover a hidden code before a real missile system can be activated.

s02e06.description: Chuck’s college girlfriend Jill returns when her scientist boss is implicated in a deadly bioweapon case, reviving old feelings while Chuck tries to determine whether Jill is involved.

s02e07.description: Chuck and Jill rekindle their relationship during an investigation into corrupt intelligence officers, while Sarah’s official role as Chuck’s girlfriend makes the situation increasingly uncomfortable.

s02e08.description: Chuck learns that Jill is a Fulcrum operative and must continue pretending to trust her long enough to locate her handler and expose the organization’s next move.

s02e09.description: Casey’s former martial-arts mentor Ty Bennett resurfaces as a traitor, forcing Casey to confront the man who taught him while Chuck struggles to function without Sarah beside him.

s02e10.description: Chuck discovers that the mysterious older man in Sarah’s life is her con-artist father Jack Burton, and a mission built around his scams forces Sarah to revisit the childhood she escaped.

s02e11.description: Armed thieves take the Buy More hostage on Christmas Eve, and Chuck refuses to abandon his family and friends even when Sarah and Casey urge him to stay hidden.

s02e12.description: Chuck and Sarah become bodyguards for reckless rock star Tyler Martin after an assassination attempt, leaving Chuck to manage both an international threat and an unmanageable client.

s02e13.description: Chuck and Sarah pose as a married suburban couple to investigate a seemingly perfect neighborhood that is actually a Fulcrum testing ground for its own version of the Intersect.

s02e14.description: Morgan suspects Anna is seeing another man and drags Chuck into surveillance that unexpectedly overlaps with a mission involving a dangerous criminal organization.

s02e15.description: Sarah must seduce captured operative Cole Barker to obtain Fulcrum intelligence, leaving Chuck jealous while the team tries to prevent a major intelligence leak.

s02e16.description: Chuck and Cole pursue clues about Perseus, the scientist behind Fulcrum’s Intersect, while captivity and torture test Chuck’s determination to remain involved in the mission.

s02e17.description: A mysterious figure known as Orion contacts Chuck and claims he may be able to remove the Intersect, forcing Chuck to decide whether the apparent route back to normal life is genuine.

s02e18.description: Agent Alex Forrest evaluates Sarah’s performance as Chuck’s handler and recommends separating them, making their unresolved feelings an official problem for the government.

s02e19.description: Chuck’s estranged father Stephen returns just as Chuck is offered a dream job by Ted Roark, only for both men to become linked to the Intersect and Fulcrum’s plans.

s02e20.description: After Fulcrum kidnaps Stephen, Chuck turns to imprisoned former girlfriend Jill for help locating him and must decide how much he can trust someone who already betrayed him.

s02e21.description: Chuck and Sarah go rogue to rescue Stephen from Fulcrum, with Casey ordered to hunt them down as their feelings for each other become increasingly impossible to dismiss.

s02e22.description: Ellie and Devon’s wedding is attacked by Fulcrum, forcing Chuck’s spy life into his family celebration before he makes a decisive choice about a new Intersect with abilities far beyond the original.
